tours.heading: Chinaman's Hat Self-Guided Kayak Tour
tours.text: Experience ocean kayaking to Mokoliʻi on our Chinaman's Hat Self-Guided Kayak Tour*. We provide everything you need to have a great and safe time out on the water. You'll get kayaks, seat backs, life vests, dry bags safety equipment, heavy duty pads, straps and private instruction before you set out on your own to experience Chinaman's Hat. Experience this one of a kind Oʻahu adventure with plenty of epic views. We suggest this tour for individuals who are experienced in kayaking or are comfortable kayaking in the ocean.
tours.note: *We conveniently provide the kayaks and beach gear at our Kailua storefront for pickup so you can easily have a great time out on Mokoliʻi after we provide you with on-site instruction, and helpful info.

tours.heading: Mokulua Islands Guided Kayak Tour, Kailuaʻs Twin Islands
tours.subheading: Once in a Lifetime Kayak to Mokulua Island in Kailua
tours.text: Embark on an exhilarating guided kayak tour to the Twin Islands, led by our experienced guides! As we paddle towards Moku Nui, a designated bird sanctuary and we will provide permits for this adventure. Be sure to reserve your spot in advance, as availability is limited. During this 5-hour journey, you'll encounter a vibrant array of wildlife, including sea turtles, Hawaiian monk seals, tropical fish, and sea birds. If weather conditions permit, we'll explore the island's hidden tide pools and venture to its back side. This tour is ideal for physically active kayakers aged 13 years and older.
tours.note: *We conveniently provide the kayaks and beach gear at our Kailua storefront for pickup so you can easily have a great time out in Kailua Bay after we provide you with on-site instruction, and helpful info.
tours.imageAlt: Mokulua Islands Kayak Tour — Kailua Twin Islands

tours.heading: Kahana Rainforest River Kayak Self-Guided Tour
tours.text: Paddle up the Kahana River — a jungle stream with spectacular mountain views and Hawaiian heritage sites. This is a unique experience where you can explore a remote jungle river at your own pace. We provide kayaks, safety gear, and a pre-trip orientation to ensure you have a safe and memorable adventure.

sections.heading: Mokoliʻi Island
sections.text: Discover Mokoliʻi (Chinaman's Hat) — the iconic offshore island in Kualoa — and Kāneʻohe Bay with our kayak and beach gear rentals. Paddle in an ocean kayak out to the Mokoliʻi, then hike to the summit for panoramic views.
